item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Fefe Dobson
item.description:
Looking for 2 Fefe Dobson related items if possible.

Looking for the advanced copy of Joy that includes Pepper Spray and Shame specifically. Mainly a HQ version of Pepper Spray would be amazing.

It's been posted here before but the person who uploaded it no longer has it: https://sharemania.us/threads/fefe-dobson-joy-advance-copy.129705/ - Anyone download it and still have it?

Also, one other song is a HQ version of Celebrate which is available on Canada iTunes and other Canadian sites:
https://music.apple.com/ca/album/celebrate-single/1445306377
https://www.qobuz.com/ca-en/album/celebrate-fefe-dobson/goqwvdws4j1ac

Not sure if it's lossless or flac or anything, but just the i+ version would be nice to have.
